title: Principles check
instructions: Four questions on the five principles.

questions.prompt: Which principle means giving the AI a clear goal, relevant context and your constraints?
questions.explanation: Direct is about instructions. A precise request gets something you can use.

questions.prompt: An assistant gives you average(numbers) = sum(numbers) / len(numbers). It fails on an empty list. Which principle would have caught it?
questions.explanation: Verify means reading, running and testing generated code, including edge cases like an empty list.

questions.prompt: If you could not maintain a system without the AI, which principle are you missing?
questions.explanation: Own means you understand the system, can change it, and are accountable for it.

questions.prompt: Choosing between two architectures for a project belongs to which kind of competence?
questions.explanation: Weighing alternatives and trade-offs is engineering judgment.
